_notes.players: One or more people who drill on this device. name: what the page calls them. level: where they start, 1 (early school) to 10 (sharp); the drill adapts from there. kid: true drops the timer, enlarges the keys, uses the rounded type, and celebrates every finish.
_notes.operations: Any of add, subtract, multiply, divide, percent, squares. Each player can switch some off on the Start screen.
_notes.seconds: How long a timed drill runs. 0 means untimed: ten problems, no clock. Kid players are always untimed.
_notes.theme: chalk (a blackboard), candy (cream and bright keys), slate (gray with one accent), or auto (slate by day, chalk at night, candy for kid players). Each one has a light and a dark look that follows the device.
